message.content: This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine. At the top, the white masthead reads "TEMPO" in a serif typeface, with "SIASAT PARTAI LOLOS VERIFIKASI KPU / CERUK BARU BISNIS DATA RAKSASA" above it and "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below. The central image depicts two men standing on a broad, curved rainbow that arcs across a sky filled with grey clouds. On the left, a man in a grey suit and black shoes is hunched over, holding a small brush and painting a red stripe onto the rainbow. On the right, another man wearing a light grey robe, trousers, and a white head covering is also bent over, using a long-handled roller to apply white paint over the rainbow's colors. Large black text below them reads "MENGAPA LGBT DIMUSUHI," followed by smaller text: "KEKERASAN TERHADAP LESBIAN, GAY, BISEKSUAL, DAN TRANSGENDER MENINGKAT. DAMPAK POLITISASI MENJELANG PEMILU?" At the bottom right, there is a white box containing a barcode and publication details: "5-11 FEBRUARI 2018", "RP 45.000", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273". A solid red border runs down the left edge.
